context: Hello! I am here to help with with a movie recommendation.
I love seeing a new movies! I often like to go for comedy
I am a sucker for a good comedy as well! What is the last comedy that you have seen?
I recently just watch Murder Mystery with Adam Sandler
Adam Sandler is great! I loved him in Bedtime Stories!
great movie! Love the plot of how imagination became real life.
You are so right! I was surprised at how appealing it was to adults and kids alike.
yes. Do you recommend any comedic movies you have seen recently?
Actually, Ive heard good things about beach bum! Adam Sandler is not starring but it seems like something even he would enjoy!
I never heard of it! what is the plot?
Its about a stoner played by Matthew McConaughey that lives life by his own rules.
I love Matthew McConaughey! Great recommendation I'll definitely watch!
Good deal! I'm adding that one to my list as well!
I also do like a good Horror Movie as well, not so much paranormal. But more suspenseful, Do you have any recommendations?
I don't have as much experience with horror  but Id love to send you the trailer for Beach Bum, if you're interested?
Sure I would love to see the trailer
Great! I'll get that ready for you.
That would be great thanks!
While that is gearing up, I did some research on some recommended horror flicks.
Oh great! I love a thriller, in the day light of course
I'm with you there!
What is your reccomendation?
Have you seen Us? or Midsommar?
I have seen Us. What a great movie! I have not seen midsommar. What is the plot?
It is about a couple traveling to Sweden to visit a popular mid-summer festival. There is a twist that makes this more than an idyllic vacation tour.
That sounds interesting I'll definitely look into it! thanks for your recommendations
I am glad to help!

context.content: Hi! Looking for something to watch? Do you prefer comedy, drama, thriller, or maybe a mix?
I'm in the mood for a good comedy! Got any recommendations?
I'd recommend 'Somebody Up There Likes Me (2012)'. It's a light-hearted comedy that might bring a smile to your face.
Hey there! I love a good comedy. Can you tell me more about 'Somebody Up There Likes Me'? Like, what's the plot about and who are the main actors?

'Somebody Up There Likes Me' is a charming comedy about a man and his best friend navigating life while both harboring feelings for the same woman. It's heartwarming and funny, perfect for a good laugh and some emotional warmth. Would love to hear your thoughts after watching it! 🎬😄
Would you like to know about another movie too?
Sounds interesting! Can you tell me more about the actors and their roles? Also, is it available on streaming platforms? [END] Seeking more details to ensure it fits my preferences.
